brief: TOP PICK: OpenMontage (opp 9, breakout) — Agentic video production studio for AI coding assistants. Highest-rated opportunity. Build now.
TREND: Agent skills/frameworks exploding — mattpocock/skills, obra/superpowers, addyosmani/agent-skills all breakout. Production-grade skills for AI coders are the new moat.
INFRA: AI agent tooling is hot — memory hubs, security routers, multi-model gateways (330+ providers, 1200+ models) all breakout. Toolchain is the wedge.
TIMING: 3+ breakouts this week in the AI coding assistant ecosystem. First mover advantage in agentic video + skills frameworks expires in 60 days.

items.name: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.one_liner: Open-source agentic video production studio for AI coding assistants
items.pain_point: Video production is expensive and complex; indie creators, small studios, and marketers need affordable, automated workflows but lack budget for Adobe/Premiere subscriptions and professional teams
app_ideas: Browser-based video editor with OpenMontage backend and cloud rendering
AI short-form content generator for TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts from blog posts or scripts
Automated product demo/tutorial video pipeline for SaaS companies
items.monetization: Freemium cloud credits for rendering + B2B API wrapper for agencies
items.why_now: AI video generation is exploding and 5% weekly star growth signals massive creator demand for affordable production tools
